name: Tamurkhan, the Maggot Lord
canonNotes: A great Kurgan champion of Nurgle who can burrow into hosts and puppet their bodies; his favoured host is the Ogre Tyrant Karaka Breakmountain.
Gathers a vast horde to fulfil a prophecy of plague and terror across the Chaos Wastes and beyond.
voiceNotes: Commanding, grotesque and ambitious; speaks as a conqueror-king.
Treats bodies and allies as vessels to be used.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
